notes.title: Electrician Simulator VR - Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 [b]Electrician Simulator VR is OUT NOW![/b] ⚡[/h1]

The wait is over—[i]Electrician Simulator VR[/i] is officially [b]LIVE![/b] 🥳🔧 Step into the role of an electrician like never before and experience what it’s like to repair, install, and rewire in a fully immersive VR world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312719/75f1872e3cf6b06995997749b27f8eb57b0895b6.png[/img]

💡 What’s new in Electrician Simulator VR?

🔧 Fully reimagined for VR – Every mission has been redesigned from the ground up to take full advantage of immersive, hands-on gameplay.
⚡ More interactivity – Handle tools, connect wires, and fix electrical issues with precision using intuitive VR controls.
💡 New challenge system – Put your skills to the test with extra tasks that encourage creative problem-solving.
🏠 Explore detailed environments – Work on a variety of jobs, from small repairs to full electrical installations.

💥 Why VR?
Electricity isn’t something you just look at—it’s something you interact with. That’s why Take IT Studio! brought [i]Electrician Simulator[/i] to VR! Feel the weight of the tools in your hands, carefully connect wires, and experience the thrill of fixing electrical issues up close. The added immersion makes every job more engaging, whether you’re a seasoned electrician or just learning the ropes.

🛠️ A fresh take on the original experience
If you’ve played [i]Electrician Simulator[/i] before, get ready for a completely new approach. While the desktop version was all about precision and strategy, VR takes the experience to another level with real-world interactions, physical problem-solving, and a sense of scale you can’t get on a flat screen. Every mission has been tailored for VR to make sure it feels natural, rewarding, and fun!

So grab your headset, put on your work gloves, and see if you have what it takes to become a pro electrician—or maybe just avoid getting zapped! ⚡ Let us know what you think and share your experiences!

notes.title: Summary of the year
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Electricians, [/h1]

Today is a special day as we are celebrating the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080020/Electrician_Simulator/][b]Electrician Simulator[/b][/url] anniversary! This is not only an occasion to celebrate, but also a moment to look back at how much we have achieved over the past year. We would like to share with you our successes and updates, both big and small, and thank you for the support we have received from our fantastic community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/3fee410c4524b0d0ca28ecd1fcf855d4924d2534.jpg[/img]

Over the past year, we have been constantly working on improving the game by listening to your feedback and suggestions. Here is what we have managed to do:
[list]
[*] [b]On 21 September, the game was launched[/b] with a 20% discount to celebrate reaching [b]9,000 community members[/b]. There was also a stream and a contest.
[*] The first patch was released in September 2022, tweaking the game and fixing minor bugs.
[*] A month later, another patch was released, taking into account the community's comments and introducing important fixes and new features. We were also present at [b]PGA 2022[/b], where we had some of the activities prepared for you.
[*] In November, we fixed bugs, added exciting Halloween missions and add-ons, and introduced Steam Community Items. [b]Electrician Simulator also became on Steam Deck[/b].
[*] Not much later, we introduced Score the Goal! - football-related content and discounted the game by 30% in the [b]Steam Autumn Sale[/b].
[*] In December, we added winter content, introduced a roadmap, and refreshed the Steam card.
[*] Since January, we have been focusing on community feedback and working on new features related to Valentine's Day and the new mode.
[*] In February we introduced an update with Valentine's Day decor and items.
[*] March was dedicated to perfecting the new mode that arrived in April - [b]Endless Mode[/b]. Meanwhile, we were polishing the Smart Devices DLC.
[*] In May, [b]Smart Devices DLC[/b] was released.
[*] In June, we ran another contest for our community and participated in the [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b], offering another discount.
[/list]We would like to express our immense gratitude to you, our amazing community. Your passion and dedication have been incredibly inspiring to us. It is because of you that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080020/Electrician_Simulator/][b]Electrician Simulator[/b][/url] has become what it is today.

[h2]Sale[/h2]
Finally, don't forget about the ongoing discount on Steam! All discounts are only available until [i]September 25[/i], so if you don't already have [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080020/Electrician_Simulator/][b]Electrician Simulator[/b][/url] in your collection, this is the perfect time to get it. Enjoy the game at [b]50% off[/b] and also check out our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2329870/Electrician_Simulator__Smart_Devices/][b]DLC Smart Devices[/b][/url] at [b]20% off[/b]!

Thank you again for this amazing year with you and we can't wait to see what the future holds. We can reveal that we are preparing something exciting for you soon, but more on that later. We wish you amazing gameplay and electrifying fun!

notes.title: New smart world
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Electricians,[/h1]

In the last devlog, we briefly mentioned the [b]new DLC[/b] we are working on. Today, we want to talk a little bit about the expansion and why we came up with the idea of making one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/9558ce3fd2438eb6376d085a0d37c439d2ec31fc.jpg[/img]

[h2]Our inspiration[/h2]
There is no denying that you - the loyal fans of [b]Electrician Simulator[/b] - and more specifically the votes you cast in our survey, have contributed to the creation of this DLC. We were pleasantly surprised by such a huge response and are very grateful for your help. In addition, we are fans of smart devices ourselves and we are using such devices daily whatever we are! Whether it's the office or home, gadgets like smart speakers, wireless bulbs, or wi-fi cameras are tools that make our lives easier on every occasion. We felt that our familiarity with those devices and the idea of wireless connections will be a solid foundation for such DLC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/15480d0529b2b0d4f263f97cd5157950230f579f.jpg[/img]
[h2]Smart Devices - what exactly is it?[/h2]
DLC will bring a new, but well-known to everyone - wireless network. That connection will allow a completely new approach to electrical design and open up new avenues when troubleshooting customer problems. Of course, the changes will also bring even more missions, repair gadgets and mechanics that even the most experienced electrician could not have dreamed of!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/acf7f953ab0acd0673118088828edb29491249d4.jpg[/img]
If you are as excited about the [b]Smart Devices DLC[/b] as we are, be sure to add it to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2329870/Electrician_Simulator__Smart_Devices/]wishlist![/url] New smart gameplay awaits you - our Electricians!

notes.title: Meet the Endless Mode
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Electricians,[/h1]

The day has finally arrived - in front of you [b]Endless Mode![/b] Endless tasks, new features and even more challenges. Many of you have been asking us to extend the gameplay time, so this update is especially for you!

[h2]Endless Mode in a Nutshell[/h2]
From now on, the game will feature infinite procedurally generated repair missions and client house tasks. Random items will appear on the workbench - each with a different defect, and houses will have an even more diverse layout! 

The new layout of devices and apartments will make the game surprise you at every turn.

[previewyoutube=aCHk9airYsc;full][/previewyoutube]

The Unlock Pass will allow you to run the gameplay at your own tempo. Repair broken equipment, go on missions and gain experience to unlock various interesting rewards and tasks. New challenges and customers with various problems are already waiting for you - the best electricians!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/e555563d4821ed85305fe095d2806e84108eb81b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Smart Devices DLC[/h2]
Endless Mode does not mean the end of work on Electrician Simulator. We are just working on [b]Smart Devices DLC[/b] - a paid DLC that will introduce new items, interesting tasks, and unique mechanics that will allow you to discover a completely different side of the work of an electrician! 

You are kindly invited to add [b]Smart Devices DLC[/b] to your wishlist! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2329870/Electrician_Simulator__Smart_Devices/

notes.title: Working on Endless Mode - Part 4
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Electricians,[/h1]

In today's devlog, we're taking another look at the upcoming [b]Endless Mode[/b]. At the very end, we've saved some more interesting information for you about the new update, [b]which will be released on the 4th of April! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/95d27f31ed358f885a74d2a61ff2c818156027c0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Why the Endless Mode?[/h2]
After the release, the completion time of our game was not enough for a large number of you.
We carefully analyzed all the reviews and messages we received and took it as a point of honor to release the update you mostly asked for. We hope to meet your expectations!

With the [b] Endless Mode[/b] and [b]Unlock Pass[/b], everyone will be able to enjoy the game as much as their heart desires!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fEJx10Q.gif[/img]

[h2]What was our inspiration for the new mode?[/h2]
We have been inspired by the roguelike genre in which each campaign we start looks different, but is closed within the framework of objectives and mechanics. We can have to deal with customers problems instead of fighting enemies treat the houses or items on the workbench as a "dungeon"

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qg2QUG8.gif[/img]

[h2]What about the DLC for Electrician Simulator?[/h2]

We are happy to announce that work on the DLC has already started some time ago and we are working on the add-on. We will let you know soon but that will be after the release of [b]Endless Mode[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/r0Z9HYP.gif[/img]

[b]We hope you are looking forward to the new mode and are as excited as we are![/b]

See you soon!

In [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1080020/announcements/detail/3685671924899709621]the last devlog[/url] we write about working on [b]the workshop in Endless Mode[/b]. [h2]What is an "Unlock Pass"?[/h2]
The inspiration for our new feature was all sorts of season passes that we can find in multiplayer games. Such a solution usually motivates the player to discover new things, so we decided to implement this form in our [b]Electrician Simulator[/b].

The [b]Unlock Pass[/b] will be [b]free[/b] and will not have a time limit, so each of you will be able to unlock more levels and earn rewards at a pace that suits you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/a5a986fb8f2ee8ed523c810ab09ab994ea0f7962.jpg[/img]

Once you're familiar with the new form, there will be bigger locations, more complicated repairs in the workshop, and much more!

By using this approach, we know that [b]Endless Mode[/b] will challenge you at every step!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/bd173c40b55fbaf0d2afd7a0c19fc475ed360f45.jpg[/img]

An additional variety of gameplay are [b]modifiers[/b] - thanks to them, seemingly similar missions can put a completely different challenge to the player. For example, there may be restrictions on the length of a single cable, time, and much more...

[h3]Three New Missions[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Save the Snowman[/b] - One of our customers has a snowman friend that he keeps in the refrigerator so that he can survive as long as possible. Unfortunately, something happened and there is no electricity in the fridge! You need to fix this issue as soon as possible because if you fail, the snowman will disappear forever.

[*] [b]House lighting contest[/b] - One of our customers is taking part in a contest for the best house lighting. He has already put up all the decorations, but when the TV came down to record the Christmas competition, it turned out that not everything works as it should. Save your client, fix the Christmas decorations, and help him win the competition!

[*] [b]Surprise mission[/b] - In this mission, one of our old customer's returns and asks us for help again. Here you already have to discover for yourselves who it might be...[/list]

notes.content:
[h1]Dear Electricians,[/h1]

[b]We've got a November update for you with new content[/b]. We're constantly working to bring you as much additional content as possible, we know that's what you as a community expect from us.  

Are you interested to know what we have prepared for you? It is well known that the work of an electrician is dangerous and he can be shocked by electricity. And have you ever wondered what also can shock him? Well, the result of a match when his favorite team is playing!

Football is one of those hobbies that unites our team. We love playing it and watching it together in the pub. That's why we decided, on the occasion of the upcoming World Cup, to prepare [b]updates related to football[/b].

The mission, store items, and repair table tasks stay with us permanently and are not a time-limited event.

notes.content:
[h1]Dear Electricians,[/h1]

[h3]We begin the great countdown![/h3]
[h3]Only [b]two days[/b] separate us from the most [b]electrifying premiere[/b] this autumn. We would like to thank you for your support and for following our project![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/71e549ecfde2370517fd5ef533f557633505de91.png[/img]

A task in [b]Electrician Simulator[/b] does not always have to concern a non-working installation or a malfunctioning switch. In the game, you will also get the opportunity to repair electrical devices. 

[previewyoutube=1JRTdu2yAo4;full][/previewyoutube]
The repair procedure itself is not complicated. To begin with, you need to select a message from your inbox that contains the appropriate order. It can be a request to repair the dryer, non-working headphones, or toaster. Once you have accepted the task, you should go to the workbench located in the garage. There you will find the item ordered for repair and available tools. In case of problems, you can use hints that will guide you on what to do at the moment.

We listened hard to the players' comments,corrected the inconsistencies found in the prologue version and added a whole bunch of new items and locations.

[previewyoutube=JCfCGs9Ccbg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]We collected your feedback from the First Shock which we very much appreciated, thank you! By the way we wanted to answer the most popular questions in our community:[/h3]

[b]1. Will this game be genderless? Can you pick who you would like to play?[/b]
We are writing the story elements right now and we’ve heard the players’ feedback. As much as we respect the LGBTQ+ Community, we are unable to incorporate all non-binary options due to limited time before the premiere. This is why we’ve made a decision to use gender-neutral dialogue options.

[b]2. Will there be more electric systems in the game, not only in Europe? US/Asia standards? A menu where the player can select what region, and then use that to show different color schemes, wires types and electric panel?[/b]
We have decided to place the whole game in a fictional town in order to be able to explain the differences from the real world. We’ve heard all your feedback and we are currently planning post-release support for the game. Depending on its success, we might be able to introduce DLCs with extra standards.

[b]3. Would it be possible to implement panel wiring such as motor starter panels (Star/Delta, cap-start/cap-run, DOL starters and sequence starters) this platform could be used for more than just fun, it could be used to educate electrician apprentices or people wanting to get into the electrical field?[/b]
As much as we would love to expand features and introduce as many appliances and panels as possible, we are not experts in electricity, education nor providing educational software. It is something to look at in the future, depending on the game’s success.

[b]4. Will there be VR?[/b]
Not at the moment, however it depends on the game’s commercial success.

[b]5. Is this game gonna be accurate in terms of appliances?[/b]
We are trying to introduce as many original appliances in the game as possible, including workbench items and job-related materials. Please keep in mind that this is a game and it’s supposed to be fun - some appliances may differ for gamification reasons (if an appliance is very interesting but complicated, we reduce it a bit so it doesn’t become an issue to complete a task in-game).

[b]6. Will the game support ultrawide monitors?[/b]
We are testing available solutions at the moment but are unable to confirm this feature at the moment.

[b]7. Will ES have steam cards and achievements?[/b]
Yes.

[b]8. Why does the garage look similar to Phasmophobia?[/b]
Because the same asset pack was used for the Prologue. A new garage was created for the full version of the game. The Prologue was a technological demo allowing us to check our ideas against our audience and make decisions that will benefit players. We were focused on mechanics and the joys of gameplay, as well as introducing story elements in a simulator. The garage was effectively a placeholder. And we like Phasmaphobia.

[b]9. Will there be multiplayer?[/b]
No.

[b]10. Why is it called a simulator if it is not realistic?[/b]
The game is as realistic as it is possible from our perspective. Unfortunately, it is not easy to move all the real-world mechanics into games. Many games with the word “simulator” in their title are not realistic at all. The majority of principles are based on how things work in the real world, many have been changed slightly to simply make the game a game, and to provide a joyful gameplay along with a pleasant experience.

[b]11. What sort of missions will we have that we haven't seen in a demo?[/b]
That’s a secret - you need to purchase the game to find out or await official media communications around the release date. We are almost certain that our original approach to this topic shall make everyone happy with the solution to this problem.

[b]12. Will there be proper wire colours in full game as in real life every color has its meaning?[/b]
Cable color-coding is specific for different countries and regions, so it is very difficult to provide players from all around the globe gameplay representative for their region. This is why we’ve made a decision to place the whole story in a fictional country in a fictional town with its own standards and coding.

[b]13. Can you delete the timer in the final game or give the option in the menu to turn it off?[/b]
The timer has been introduced for the players that enjoy a time-related challenge or speedruns. It does not introduce any bonuses nor penalties, it is there so that players can check themselves against the timer.

notes.title: Devlog #9 - We have a connection
notes.content:
[h2]Hello there![/h2]

After the warmly received "Electrician Simulator - First Shock", we are back to work on the full version of the game! Many things are happening in the project, and we are ready to show you the first new feature.

As you may remember from the prologue version, you could connect some electrical devices to outlets and... they just worked! Some of you didn't like our stiff cables. We hear you, so we've added [b]physics[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lRq9BuE.gif[/img]

Now you can grab pretty every cable you see and play with it! Then plug it into the outlet and get that electricity flowing! But what if you can find only one outlet and you need to have more devices connected? That sounds like a problem.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RCoLkqE.gif[/img]

Well, not for us! You can use our newly created extension cord! Just plug those little fellas into their big brother and see how it works. But if you like to connect one extension cord to another? Well, you will have to test it on your own after the game releases (but it will not disappoint you).

We don't just pretend that our electricity system works. It [b]really[/b] works. So if you connect a few devices to our extension cord and you want to turn them off, you can just press the magic button on the cord. It's really that simple!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RXM5Hwt.gif[/img]


We also work on new workbench items, we add a placement system for light switches, lamps, and electrical devices, but we also let you change some bulbs, which you always really wanted!

Let us know what else you would like to see in our devlogs. We will try to update you a little bit more often.

Finally, we would like to share a information about upcoming game from our friends - [b]Bakery Simulator[/b]! If you are into baking pastries check it out! [b]The premiere will be on the 3rd of May, 18:00 CEST / 9:00 AM PDT[/b], let's show for our friends some support!

notes.title: Devlog #6 - Wire you here?
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

Today we want to show you a new game mechanic we have been working on. You have already seen some of our electrical objects, such as lamps, switches etc. But how do you connect them? They need some wires, don't they?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/b7aa5ffe645c014f3234388856954c2d82571b94.png[/img]

We implemented a new system of connecting those objects. Now, a lamp needs to be connected to the switch. And then, the switch needs to be connected to the fuse. Yes, our fusebox is working now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/e996b6b992ebffb1f6fd5dba08990a811b9d2d79.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/T4LCgKv.gif[/img]

And then there is a wire detector. Just click on the switch to check all of the wires connected to it. If they are green - there is electricity. If they are red - you need to check what is wrong.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/eb85d20faa6a50e3c39c6310815490c08b9bcd35.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/858fee5fc8e7fe1e9b366595aeb7f1992fd7fcdb.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Unique customers
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]

Another week, another content sneak peek 👀 

Today, we want to show you how we handle some uniqueness in Electrician Simulator. In our game, you will get a lot of tasks from a lot of different customers. How to make their houses look different? How to make sure that players feel the customers' sense of style?

[h3]The same, but different?[/h3]

Let's say people in Electrician Simulator's world buy very similar types of furniture. But it would be kind of boring if all of them look the same. That's why we create many materials variations. Now, every house and every piece of furniture can look unique, even if someone bought it in the same store.

Just look at the compilation below:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gtezgfs.gif[/img]

As you can see, not only we change furniture colours, but we also modify walls, floors and ceilings. Those changes make rooms even more unique. We can randomize every room appearance. That also means different window setups.

Can you spot all differences? ↓

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/2a70dde1db78cf8f1155a5b10d6a4e0e61fe8c87.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/581474c781e496aba657ba8da67673a97263c381.png[/img]

Who would use such blue colours in their house?! Well, non of our business. We can use more discreet colours, and you will still see the difference. The thing is that even with the same furniture given room can be unusual. Of course, it doesn't mean we only use one set of furniture and appliances. But we want to make sure that you will not spot the same place twice.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3kOkvsM.gif[/img]

[h3]Anything more?[/h3]

Yes! We started implementing a new user interface, as you can see below. But wait, what's with all of those weird words?! That's Polish language, meaning we also started working on localizing the game! You will need to wait a little bit longer for all of the languages we support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/0d87ee469cbe4056fa494d660bbb2fcf6a5496a5.jpg[/img]

[b]And that's all this week! We hope that you wait for Electrician Simulator as it encourages us to work faster and better! See you in the next Devlog! Or sooner on our Discord Server:[/b]
